cases.responseText: The inbound TRN103 is waiting for Stand B, which is occupied by TRN102.
The late baggage batch is delaying TRN102. Fuel is complete, but that does not mean baggage loading is complete.
Low-visibility procedures and safeguarding are active.
TRN103 is already occupying Stand B instead of TRN102.
Safeguarding cancellation is confirmed, but departure clearance is still unconfirmed and TRN101 remains parked. The engine has caught fire.
The cancellation of safeguarding has been confirmed. I do not know that TRN101 has departure clearance because no such confirmation was received; it remains parked.
